newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis index closes little changed in high trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis index closes little changed in high trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange on Friday closed little changed in higher trade boosted by the selling of 83,763 shares in the capital of chemical firm Alkimia, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 604.86 from 605.16 on Thursday.
Trade volume was 6.26 million dinars ($6.45 million) against 1.8 million dinars.
The main transaction was in chemical firm Alkimia, whose shares changed hands at 43.69 dinars each. Brokers said the Alkimia share seller was CODEPAR firm and the buyer was Driss Group.
Retail stores Monoprix was down 1.42 dinars to 45.94 dinars. Chemical detergents firm SPCD was up 0.94 dinar to 5.94 dinars. ($=0.97 dinar)
